summary: Gate 8 re-review of PR #77 (NFR-REL-001 Auto-Save Crash Durability). All 5 prior findings verified as resolved: B1 (useAutoSave reads actual scene state from sceneStore via useSceneStore.getState()), B2 (package.json reverted to main baseline with only fake-indexeddb and globals added), M1 (ResumePrompt.test.tsx and useAutoSave.test.ts now import real production modules), M2 (console.warn added to persistenceService.ts catch block), M3 (console.warn added to all 4 catch blocks in persistenceStore.ts). However, 1 new blocking issue discovered: B3 — idb package is not listed in package.json dependencies despite being imported by dbSchema.ts. Build will fail with module-not-found error.

B1.verification: useAutoSave.ts now imports useSceneStore and calls useSceneStore.getState() inside interval callback. Reads actual bricks, cameraState, sceneMetadata with sensible fallbacks.

B2.verification: package.json diff shows only 2 lines added: fake-indexeddb ^6.0.0 and globals ^15.14.0 in devDependencies. No removed deps, no version bumps, no script removals, no name change.

M1.verification: ResumePrompt.test.tsx imports real ResumePrompt component. useAutoSave.test.ts imports real useAutoSave hook with proper mocks. crashRecoveryService.test.ts and persistenceService.test.ts still use contract stubs — acceptable for service-level IndexedDB tests.

M2.verification: console.warn('[persistenceService] Could not read existing meta:', err) added to catch block.

M3.verification: All 4 catch blocks now have console.warn with descriptive prefixes: markSessionClosed, checkForCrashRecovery, resumeSession, discardSession.

blocking.title: idb package missing from dependencies
blocking.description: Production code in dbSchema.ts imports from 'idb' but the package is not listed in dependencies or devDependencies in package.json. npm install will not install idb, causing build failure.
blocking.impact: Build will fail with 'Cannot find module idb'. All 6 production modules that depend on dbSchema.ts will be broken.

low.title: No closeDB() for HMR cleanup alongside resetDBPromise()
markSessionClosed is async in sync beforeunload — consider localStorage fallback
No focus trap in modal — track as separate WCAG accessibility issue
purgeSession() uses raw IDBKeyRange.only() — inconsistent with idb wrapper usage
existingMeta read outside atomic transaction (TOCTOU on saveCount)

passing_checks: idb library used (not raw IndexedDB) per LLD Section 13
PersistenceError class with typed error codes
isValidSnapshot() validates bricks array + schemaVersion bounds
beforeunload listener registered and cleaned up on unmount
All 10 test IDs from LLD Section 12 covered
useAutoSave reads actual scene state from sceneStore (B1 fixed)
package.json minimal diff — only fake-indexeddb and globals added (B2 fixed)
console.warn in all catch blocks (M2/M3 fixed)
ResumePrompt.test.tsx and useAutoSave.test.ts import real production modules (M1 fixed)

human_review_required.item: Gate 8 — Confirm B3 fix (idb added to package.json dependencies)

recommended_actions: Fix B3: Add '"idb": "^8.0.0"' to dependencies in frontend/package.json
Run npm install to verify idb resolves correctly
Run vitest to verify all unit tests still pass with idb installed
